question: Should `plugin-sdk/media-base64` become a supported focused Plugin SDK subpath while `plugin-sdk/media-runtime` remains a deprecated broad compatibility barrel?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin API and establishes the long-term compatibility boundary for external plugins; tests can validate behavior but cannot determine whether this API shape should be committed permanently.

options.title: Accept the focused SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive base64 subpath, retain the deprecated broad barrel for compatibility, and merge after a clean rebase and current-head validation.

options.title: Keep base64 internal for now
options.body: Avoid adding the public subpath and revise the refactor to use existing supported SDK seams until maintainers choose a broader media API plan.

options.title: Pause for a media SDK design decision
options.body: Defer the refactor until maintainers define the intended focused media subpath set and deprecation policy together.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive base64 subpath, retain the deprecated broad barrel for compatibility, and merge after a clean rebase and current-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor with direct context for both the proposed SDK split and WhatsApp migration.
